integrity: The universal claim is established by a symbolic proof. The bundled computation is a finite regression check and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem eliminates only the minimal shared \(q\)-adic layer for two-prime-support hosts with odd exponent \(b\ge3\); hosts with at least three distinct primes or with larger \(q\)-adic exponent remain unresolved.
title: Minimal shared-prime layer obstruction for odd prime-power quasi-friendly divisors
